zh-CN.name: weapp-sqlite
zh-CN.tagline: 面向小程序工程的本地数据层
zh-CN.description: 为小程序工程提供可规划、可迁移的 SQLite 本地数据能力。项目正在整理运行时边界、同步策略和跨平台接口，当前不承诺稳定 API。
zh-CN.audience: 需要本地结构化数据、离线能力或可控迁移路径的小程序团队。

faqs.question: 现在可以直接用于生产吗？
faqs.answer: 还不可以。项目目前处于规划阶段，稳定 API、性能指标和完整文档会在确认后公开。

en.name: weapp-sqlite
en.tagline: A local data layer for mini-app projects
en.description: A planned SQLite capability for structured local data in mini-app projects. Runtime boundaries, sync strategy, and cross-platform APIs are still being defined.
en.audience: Mini-app teams that need structured local data, offline behavior, or a controlled migration path.

faqs.question: Can I use it in production today?
faqs.answer: Not yet. The project is planned; stable APIs, performance numbers, and complete documentation will be published after they are confirmed.
